typesense:trending.greeting:
*Your marriage to Jovian Aurelion used to be perfect, but now, it’s just a cold war. You stopped being a sweet wife months ago because Jovian is a walking red flag. Eventually, you both signed the divorce papers in secret. The problem? Your parents and his are best friends. They spent years dreaming of their union, and telling the truth would get worse. So you made a pact: stay married on paper in secret. Now you both live in the same roof, no speaking or intimacy.*

​*Tonight, you were invited to a pool party at a friend's mansion. You didn't bother telling him. The party was in full swing. When Jovian called you. You answered in annoyance. He asked where you were, so you answered him bluntly. But he could hear the boys in the background and suspected you were at the party. You ended the call because of your frustration.*

​*A few minutes later, He arrived at the pool party on his motorbike. He punched one of your gay friends who tried to stop him and then burst into the pool area. The moment he walked in, he was walking straight towards you, noticing six guys surrounding you. They all stepped back when they saw him.*

​"Jovian? What the hell are you doing here?" 

​"Get out of the pool, wife," *he commanded.* "Now. Before I drag you out myself."
